A review of the recently available RISC-V development board, Jupiter 2, distributed by Milk V:

https://milkv.io/jupiter2

Milk-V Jupiter 2 is one of the first to ship with the new Spacemit K3 RVA23 processors. The performance of SpacemiT K3 is pretty good and a great development board that is almost ready for daily use. It's a decent option for early adopters.

A few useful notes for new users:

1. Install Ubuntu 26.04 instead of the default OS. It shipped with Bianbu, a distro based on Ubuntu. The default desktop was LXQt instead of Gnome, which complicated keyboard configuration and lacked several features. Switching to Gnome solved those issues. Images for Ubuntu are available from: https://github.com/spacemit-com/K3-Ubuntu-Images

2. It didn't ship with documentation; however, the documentation for Spacemit Pico-ITX K3 is sufficient as it is the same board: https://www.spacemit.com/community/document/info?lang=en&nodepath=hardware/eco/k3_pico/pico_user_guide.md

3. You will likely need a powered USB dock to connect to a display (capable of 65W). The ports for USB-C power and display are combined; it requires the use of a powered USB dock, or similar, to attach to a display. Otherwise, SSH is enabled by default for remote access. Displayport 4K@60hz worked via a USB hub.

4. You will need a 65W power USB-C power supply, one is not included. It can be difficult to determine if the device is on; the product lacks a clear power button or power state indicator. The power LED is only viewable at an angle from within the enclosure. A standard phone USB-C charger will likely not provide enough to keep it running consistantly and may unexpectedly power off.

The thought of producing an art book had simmered in the back of my mind for years. As an illustrator, I've always been drawn to artist books and self-published zines, yet I was well aware of the work required, and never mustered up the courage to start.

Until I stumbled upon a beautifully designed book that ignited the spark I needed. That book was Project Japan: Metabolism Talks. It was the opposite of the large, loud, colourful books that scream for attention, of which I saw so many while hunting for inspiration.

I wanted to create a book like Project Japan, and all my design decisions flowed from it. I chose matte textured stock, the kind commonly used for printing novels. The typography is Untitled Sans by Klim Type Foundry, close to Arial or Helvetica, and as the name implies, it's not an outspoken typeface. The cover is also a matte softcover, reinforcing the feel of a 'zine on steroids'.

I wanted to create a humble artist book. I hope I succeeded.

First: Anyone with multiple profiles using clients that have their own multi-account switchers has had to manually approve every action so the signer can stay in sync with whichever account is in use. This gets annoying when all you want to to do is browse the timeline, and post comments or reactions. To solve this, I’m introducing a mode where you can auto-approve every action by the signer for between 5 and 30 minutes. As long as you don’t switch accounts on the client, you keep signing as the pinned identity in Sidecar. A countdown timer at the bottom shows you when the permissions will reset. You can stop the timer whenever you want, and start a new one.

Second: To access any functions of the wallet (other than zapping), you currently have to switch to the wallet tab, which displays your balance and lets you send and receive payments. Soon, you’ll be able to pin the balance to the top of the Sidecar window, giving you  send and receive button, and a toggle to hide/show the balance. Unpin it with a single click.

许多人认为这是中国特有的现象

中美年轻人，几乎同时对婚恋进行了再定价

硅谷创业者面临的问题是，随着互联网发展，短视频普及，女生的的婚恋门槛在飞速提高。
红脖子时代，一份中产收入，百万美元的身家，往往就被视为婚恋的终局点，一份美满的生活。
但现在，伴随着短视频普及，纽约上城区富人的生活被大众知晓，新生代女性下意识的就会进行对标。

此时一个非常现实的问题就出现了，相比财富条件的明确差异，女性颜值的差异，在短视频时代往往被美颜软件大大稀释，双方的婚恋估值因此出现错位。

这段内容有点拗口，但我在第一时间就get到了他的意思，这不就是国内的配得感吗？
男生的财富量级是明确量化的，三千月薪地铁上班，月薪十万滑雪度假，亿万富翁私人飞机，不同层级的差异肉眼可见。
但女生的颜值很难精确评估，尤其在美颜时代

在90%的女生眼里，自己的颜值都属于中等偏上那一列，虽然不如上城区顶美，黄浦江名媛，但差异有限。
因此，当她刷到一个黄浦江名媛找到亿万富翁的时候，她的判断往往是，自己和对方差不多，再不济也要找一个身家千万的。

这就是配得感的理念由来，
理解这个你也就理解了这两年婚恋市场上流行的A8,A9体系，这套体系的关键就在于对身价差异也进行了模糊化。
A8对应八位数身价，千万级资产，A9对应九位数身价，亿万富翁。

在传统叙事下，月薪三千和千万资产是天壤之别，
月薪三千的女生找一个年薪百万的霸道总裁只会出现在小说电视剧里

一个月薪三千的女生看起来收入不高，但连薪水带父母房产，往往能摸到百万体量，也就是A7
A7级别的女生，中等偏上的颜值，找一个A8层级的男生，这个要求听起来是不是就很合理了呢？只差了一级，能叫高攀吗？
所以这两年所有婚恋红娘全在纠结A8，原因就在这里

这就是没有计算配得感差异，月薪三千的北上广女生，对标的其实是A8层级，也就是千万富翁~
一个原本该找千万富翁的人，陪你住出租屋吃外卖，你说是不是陪你吃苦了呢？

中国男生在这种情况下退出了婚恋市场。而硅谷的创业者们，在美国更赤裸的市场经济环境下，得到了更赤裸的答案——“单身直到B轮”

B轮是一个非常微妙的节点，刚好处于公司增长和个人价值的拐点。
天使轮和A轮的公司处于生存模式，财富前景也没有兑现，此时进入婚姻等于在低位卖出，蠢到老家。
而C轮和上市，财富虽然从千万级变成亿万富翁，但中间往往需要非常久的发展期。
只有B轮比较特殊，B轮意味着商业模式被验证，大风投进场，股票期权和未来发展都开始明确。他也是你财富量级爆发，从百万走向千万的时刻，
无论是继续单身，还是选择伴侣，都可以有的放矢。

并且，他们还发现，财富量级对于恋爱市场存在一个边际效应，
达到千万之前处处受限，可一旦达到，就通关游戏。

这个现象和国内婚恋市场几乎完美印证，大超说媒做过很多相亲局，他就发现一个现象，那就是普通相亲局，在国内婚恋市场没有举办意义。

月薪三千的去打工人相亲局
月薪一万的去中产相亲局
年薪百万的去高端相亲局，对不对

月薪三千的女生瞄准的是年薪百万高端局，月薪一万的女生瞄准的也是高端局，没有女生愿意去打工人相亲局，所有人都认为自己颜值中等偏上，应该去年薪百万的高端局。

中美两国的聪明人都发现了一个情况
传统时代，创业周期较长，财富积累也需要时间，因此先成家再立业
